mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_menu_usage_stat (user_id, menu_id, menu_name, route_path, use_count, last_use_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{menuId}, #{menuName}, #{routePath}, #{useCount}, #{lastUseTime}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, menu_id) DO UPDATE SET menu_name = EXCLUDED.menu_name, route_path = EXCLUDED.route_path, use_count = sys_menu_usage_stat.use_count + EXCLUDED.use_count, last_use_time = GREATEST(sys_menu_usage_stat.last_use_time, EXCLUDED.last_use_time)
